stem: An incident investigation relies on records from several systems with different timestamps and naming conventions. What improvement best strengthens future traceability?
choices: Standardize identifiers and time conventions across linked records, define required fields, and preserve controlled connections among crop, room, equipment, and work events
Require workers to write longer narrative notes without standardized identifiers
Store each record type separately and prohibit cross-references
rationale: Consistent identifiers, time conventions, and linked event records make it possible to reconstruct operations and investigate deviations across systems.
